decision:
step: 4 | missing: whether gift cards can be used as a payment method at checkout
The payment methods list (kb/08-payment-billing-faq.md) does not mention gift cards; kb/15-gift-cards.md says gift cards can be used "online or in-store" but does not specify checkout payment flow details. However, kb/15-gift-cards.md does explicitly state gift cards can be used online or in-store, which answers the question.

Reconsidering: kb/15-gift-cards.md says "They never expire and can be used online or in-store." This directly addresses using a gift card as payment. The payment FAQ lists accepted payment methods but is about credit cards/digital wallets — it's a different kind of question. The gift card policy directly says they can be used online or in-store, which is the answer.

cases.text:
Yes! Trailforge gift cards can be used online or in-store, so you're all set to apply one toward your order at checkout. They never expire, so there's no rush to use it either.

If you need to check your gift card balance beforehand, you can do so on the website using your card number and PIN. (kb/15-gift-cards.md)

Let me know if there's anything else I can help with!
